summary: Bell Canada filed a press release announcing an upsizing of its cash tender offers to purchase up to C$1,000,000,000 aggregate principal (increased from C$400,000,000) of ten series of outstanding MTN debentures. Consideration is based on a fixed spread plus reference security yield as of June 4, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The offers are subject to a financing condition and other conditions. This is a Canadian issuer tender for its own debt, corresponding to a US issuer tender offer. The offer period remains open; watch tender results and financing completion.
